global_rules: Bodies exclude the footer. The app appends emailComplianceFooter() (ManHair, 20 Heron, Lake Forest, CA 92630, +1 (904) 526-8500, info@manhaironline.com, manage link). Phase 2 marketing also needs {{unsubscribe_url}}.
body_html is a fragment. Wrap it in the existing confirmationHtml() shell (cream/ink/copper). Style a.mh-button like the current 'Open your account' button. HTML-escape every variable value.

All dates are from Stripe or staff records, formatted in America/Los_Angeles (formatStudioDay/formatStudioTime). Appointment times use the appointment's own timeZone. Never compute or guess a date in copy.
Unresolved variables block the send. Optional lines (card_last4, invoice_url, lead_message, lead_preferred_contact, pause_decline_reason, ghl_error) are dropped when empty, never shown blank.
Recheck state immediately before every delayed send (paid? paused? cancelled? appointment changed?). Skip if the condition no longer holds.
Dedupe per member + template + business transition. Stripe retries of the same invoice never restart grace and never re-send day-0 notices.

Member SMS: send only with recorded SMS consent (SMS_CONSENT_TEXT 2026-11-09-tcpa covers membership/visits/billing, not marketing). Recheck STOP/DND before each send. Quiet hours: send 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM in the member's local time (default America/Los_Angeles); queue anything outside the window until 9:00 AM. Billing SMS with the portal link render as about 170-185 characters, which is 2 segments. Staff operational texts are not these templates: they go only to STAFF_ALERT_SMS_NUMBERS, ignore member consent and quiet hours, and still require MEMBERSHIP_SMS_SEND=true.
Phase 2 = disabled: marketing (nurture, abandoned signup, win-back, review request), events not modeled in the app (order placed, system ready, no-show), optional monthly reminder, and staff SMS.
Monthly receipt: suppress if Stripe automatic receipt emails are on.

Consultations are booked with our ManHair stylist at {{booking_url}}. No calendar-sync, sales-tax, medical, or result-guarantee claims. Customer copy says 'our ManHair stylist' or 'our team', never a staff member's name.

merge_variables.name: first_name
merge_variables.source: member.firstName (MemberRecord). For leads: first token of deal.name (needs adding for lead templates)

merge_variables.name: next_charge_date
merge_variables.source: member.nextChargeAt formatted with formatStudioDay; must be Stripe-sourced

merge_variables.name: billing_portal_url
merge_variables.source: Stable deep link e.g. `${origin}/account/?open=billing` that signs in (or asks for a sign-in link) and then creates a FRESH Stripe portal session (bpc_1UZPyXGiafo5ImyEcopKjnZr). Do not embed a raw Stripe portal session URL in email: those expire quickly.

merge_variables.name: appointment_date_time
merge_variables.source: AppointmentRecord.startsAt + timeZone formatted e.g. 'Tue, Nov 17 at 2:30 PM PST' in the appointment's timeZone

merge_variables.name: failed_amount
merge_variables.source: Stripe invoice.amount_due (sum of open monthly invoices). InvoiceRecord stores only amountPaid today

merge_variables.name: failed_payment_date
merge_variables.source: InvoiceRecord.failedAt formatted (field exists, not exposed to copy)

merge_variables.name: card_last4
merge_variables.source: Stripe charge.payment_method_details.card.last4 (not stored). If unavailable, template line must be dropped, never blank

merge_variables.name: refund_total
merge_variables.source: sum of RefundRequestRecord.amountCents for the case

merge_variables.name: pause_resume_date
merge_variables.source: planPauseApply().resumesAt is computed but not stored on member; persist it

merge_variables.name: pause_decline_reason
merge_variables.source: staff free-text on reject; sentence omitted when empty

merge_variables.name: ghl_error
merge_variables.source: sanitized CRM sync error code (no tokens)

merge_variables.name: review_url
merge_variables.source: Google review link, owner to supply

templates.subject: We got your request, {{first_name}}
templates.preheader: Book your consultation with our ManHair stylist.
templates.body_html:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thanks for reaching out to ManHair. We have your request. Book your consultation with our ManHair stylist at the ManHair booking link.

If you'd like to get started sooner, you can join online and pay before your consultation. If the consultation shows the membership isn't the right fit, we refund your setup and any membership charges in full and cancel billing. The 3-month minimum doesn't apply in that case.

Book your consultation

View memberships

The ManHair team

Questions before then? Reply to this email. It comes straight to our team.

Open your account
